features: HDR X (133 dB WDR, 107 dB per IEC 62676-5)
Intelligent Dynamic Noise Reduction / intelligent streaming
Pan/tilt up to 300/200 deg per s (turbo), 256 pre-positions
Four streams (2 configurable H.264/H.265, I-frame, M-JPEG)
IP66 / IK10 aluminum pendant housing with heater
release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (AUTODOME_IP_starligh_Data_sheet_enUS_79209435403.pdf, V7 2021). Clear-bubble IP66 pendant model. NDP-5523-Z20-P is the later order number of the same pendant camera that the datasheet marks "NDAA compliant"; NDP-5523-Z20 is "available in specific regions only". Power 20.1 W is the maximum with heater on (14.4 W standard). Sensor stated as 1/1.8-inch in the technical specifications (the overview text says 1/2-inch). Main stream max 2560x1440 from 2688x1520 effective pixels.

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.
